svg.title: Real-ESRGAN x4t
svg.desc: SRVGGNetCompact RGB super-resolution, native eval. Input 3 × 64 × 64. Shapes exclude batch.
svg.text: SRVGGNetCompact RGB super-resolution, native eval. Input 3 × 64 × 64. Shapes exclude batch.

g.text: Residual is added after pixel shuffle; no output clamp here.
32 intermediate convolutions, one stem and one output conv.
All feature convolutions have 64 channels and use bias.
PixelShuffle rearranges channels into four spatial offsets
per axis, producing a 256×256 RGB image.
This topology is structurally different from x4/x2 RRDBNet.
Source: libreyolo/models/realesrgan/nn.py and model.py. Revision a4d0ecc9e17f.
